name: Berally
rootCause: Berally, a platform for social trading using AI agents within the Berachain ecosystem, is suspected to have been hacked. The official statement reads: “Partial information of the deployer's key was leaked, leading to the sell-off of all vesting tokens and withdrawal of funds from the liquidity pool. The dApp contract remains secure and unaffected by the hack, but please temporarily revoke access to the dApp and Staking. An investigation is underway, and an update will be provided as soon as possible.”

descriptions.text: Berally, a platform for social trading using AI agents within the Berachain ecosystem, is suspected to have been hacked. The official statement reads: “Partial information of the deployer's key was leaked, leading to the sell-off of all vesting tokens and withdrawal of funds from the liquidity pool. The dApp contract remains secure and unaffected by the hack, but please temporarily revoke access to the dApp and Staking. An investigation is underway, and an update will be provided as soon as possible.”

On 14 March 2025, Berally on Berachain suffered a $90,000 loss when an attacker gained control of the project's deployer key, enabling the unauthorized draining and sale of vesting tokens. The attack led to the depletion of liquidity pools and user losses. Immediate user guidance was to revoke protocol approvals, with no further official remediation steps confirmed. A deployer key compromise enabled unauthorized privileged transactions, allowing an attacker to transfer and sell vesting tokens and drain project-held liquidity on Berachain.
